claimBoundary: These packs make external work executable; they do not claim that owner-only proof has run.

requiredEvidence: Wrangler available in an authorized release environment
Cloudflare deployment authority and production domain configured
Supabase and provider values entered through platform secret storage
Deployed /api/health and critical-route smoke tests
packs.expectedResult: Authorized deployment reports the exact version from /api/health and retains a verified rollback version.
packs.ownerAction: Authorize the production Cloudflare account/domain and provide its deployment secrets through platform secret storage.

requiredEvidence: Authorized project access
All OCADE migrations applied in documented order
Verification SQL and cross-tenant attack tests passed
Generated database types refreshed after apply
packs.expectedResult: All ordered migrations apply and two ordinary authenticated tenants fail every cross-tenant read/write attempt.
packs.ownerAction: Grant authenticated staging-project authority for migration apply and creation of two disposable unprivileged test users.

requiredEvidence: Target-OS builders for macOS and Linux (the Windows build is NOT blocked - verified building on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, see release/OCADE_P24_COMPANION_BUILD_EVIDENCE.json)
Platform signing and notarization identities
Updater signing key and controlled update endpoint
Clean-machine install update rollback and emergency-stop runtime tests
packs.expectedResult: Signed target-OS packages install, upgrade, repair, roll back and uninstall on clean machines with emergency stop preserved.
packs.ownerAction: Supply trusted Windows/macOS signing identities, Apple notarization authority and a controlled updater signing key/endpoint.

requiredEvidence: Java Android SDK ADB and target emulator or physical device
Release keystore supplied outside the repository
Push-notification project configuration
Signed bundle install pairing approval stop and recovery tests
packs.expectedResult: A signed build installs on an authorized target and proves pairing, approval, stop, reconnect and revocation without duplicate mutation.
packs.ownerAction: Provide an authorized Android emulator/device, release keystore and push-notification project configuration.

requiredEvidence: macOS Xcode and target simulator or physical device
Apple team provisioning and distribution signing
Push-notification capability and production entitlement
Archive validation install pairing approval stop and recovery tests
packs.expectedResult: The archive validates on macOS/Xcode and an authorized target proves supported App Intent/deep-link control and explicit OS refusals.
packs.ownerAction: Provide a macOS/Xcode runner, Apple team provisioning, an authorized iOS target and production entitlements.

requiredEvidence: Real supported Chrome and Edge profiles controlled through the extensionless Playwright/CDP host
Observed DOM accessibility masked-capture upload download and emergency-stop tests
Persistent approved-context authentication handoff and revocation tests
Extension-removal gate remains green; no store identity publication or extension bundle exists
packs.expectedResult: Real Chrome and Edge contexts complete DOM/accessibility/file/tab/stop actions through CDP while the extension-removal gate stays green.
packs.ownerAction: Approve a supervised real Chrome and Edge profile session, including any manual authentication handoff required by the validation sites.

requiredEvidence: Licensed target applications and exact version matrix
Observed adapter actions receipts cancellation and recovery
GPU media voice vision and long-duration workload evidence
Cross-device revocation offline recovery and security validation
packs.expectedResult: A varied licensed matrix proves reversible action, cancellation, planted-failure recovery, receipts and safe refusal through discovered routes.
packs.ownerAction: Authorize the licensed application/device matrix and supervised reversible validation actions on each target.

requiredEvidence: Authenticated access to the Supabase project that owns public.ficia_time_entries
Definition dump including RLS policies GRANTs indexes and foreign-key actions
CREATE TABLE migration ordered before 20260721153321 with verification and rollback
Full migration set applies cleanly to an empty database
packs.expectedResult: The authoritative ficia_time_entries definition is recovered, ordered before its consumers and the full empty-database apply passes.
packs.ownerAction: Grant read authority to the Supabase project that owns public.ficia_time_entries so its schema, policies, grants, indexes and foreign keys can be exported.

requiredEvidence: Consented current external-human interviews and workflow observations
Pseudonymous coverage across pain points, task frequency, risk, accessibility and regions
Independent review with no raw protected participant content retained
packs.expectedResult: Every research dimension meets distinct-participant, consent, privacy, freshness and review gates.
packs.ownerAction: Authorize recruitment and consent for the minimum external participant cohort in OCADE_STAKEHOLDER_RESEARCH_POLICY.json.

requiredEvidence: Live production health, latency, error, refusal and security-alert delivery
packs.expectedResult: Authorized production probes and alert receivers retain fresh bounded monitoring receipts.
packs.ownerAction: Authorize the production environment and named alert receivers for one health and alert-delivery exercise.

requiredEvidence: Consented alpha and beta participants
Real success, refusal, cancellation, failure and recovery receipts
Observed performance, usability and independent security review
Fail-closed exit review
packs.expectedResult: Every cohort gate carries current human/runtime evidence and the independent exit review passes.
packs.ownerAction: Authorize a consented external alpha/beta cohort and designate a distinct security/exit reviewer.

requiredEvidence: Trusted signing identity
Authorized deployment with verified rollback
Named support/on-call authority and tested escalation
Explicit announcement approval
packs.expectedResult: Launch authority approves only after signature, deployment, rollback, support and announcement evidence reconcile.
packs.ownerAction: Provide signing/deployment authorities, name support contacts and explicitly approve the release announcement.

requiredEvidence: Named on-call and incident commander
Live alert acknowledgement and communications drill
Forensic preservation and verified recovery exercise
Reviewed postmortem with owned actions
packs.expectedResult: A real exercise meets acknowledgement, communications, preservation, recovery and postmortem bounds.
packs.ownerAction: Assign the incident roles and authorize one supervised production-like incident and recovery drill.
